title: Counting Lattice Points in Minkowski Sums of Cross Polytopes
summary: Motivated by Postnikov's study of lattice-point enumeration in Minkowski sums of simplices, we investigate lattice points in Minkowski sums of cross polytopes and establish analogous results, together with several related consequences. In particular, we introduce the support-enumerator associated with Postnikov's notion of draconian sequences and show that it coincides with the $h^*$-polynomial of the corresponding root polytope.
